body: Every tool on Toolify runs fully in your browser. There is no upload step, no queue, and no account. Your files stay on your device from start to finish.

privacy.lead: Short version: your files never leave your browser, Toolify has no accounts, and analytics never sees your files.
privacy.metaDescription: Toolify privacy policy: your files never leave your browser. How analytics, consent, and contact messages work.

body: Every tool runs locally in your browser with JavaScript. Files you open are processed in memory on your own device and are never uploaded to any server.
Because nothing is uploaded, there is nothing to breach, subpoena, or leak from a Toolify server. There is no Toolify server holding your files.
Toolify uses Google Analytics 4 to count page views and tool uses, and Microsoft Clarity for heatmaps and session replays. Analytics events never carry file contents, file names, or file hashes.
The mnemonic generator pages run with analytics fully disabled. Never use a generated mnemonic for a real wallet.
Visitors in the European Economic Area see a consent banner. No analytics cookie fires before you accept, following Google Consent Mode v2. Declining keeps every tool working exactly the same.
If you write through the contact form, your name, email, and message travel to the maker so the message can be answered. They are used only for the reply and never sold or shared.
Use any tool without an account. Block analytics with your browser settings or an ad blocker and everything still works. To ask about or delete a contact message, write through the contact page.

terms.metaDescription: Toolify terms of service: free browser tools provided as is, fair use rules, and limits of liability.

body: Toolify provides free online tools that run in your browser. No account is needed and no feature sits behind a paywall.
Tools and pages may change or retire over time. Availability is best effort.
Use the tools for lawful work. Do not abuse the site, attack it, or use it to process content you have no right to process.
Automated scraping that harms availability for others is not welcome.
The tools are provided as is, without warranty of any kind. Conversions and calculations can contain mistakes: double check results that matter, especially money and wallet operations.

To the maximum extent the law allows, Toolify is not liable for any loss from using the tools, including lost files, wrong results, or missed transactions. Your files never leave your browser, so keep your own backups.
These terms may change as the site grows. Continued use after a change means acceptance. Questions about these terms go through the contact page.

faqs.a: PNG, JPG, WEBP, AVIF, ICO, PDF, SVG, HEIC, and AI files all open. HEIC decodes in your browser and AI files read through their PDF compatible portion.
Lossy formats like JPG, WEBP, and AVIF follow your quality slider. PNG output stays lossless no matter the slider.

steps.line: Lower the quality or type a target size.

steps.title: Download
steps.line: Compare before and after, then save.

faqs.q: How does the target size work?
faqs.a: The compressor re-encodes at lower quality until the file fits your target or hits the lowest usable quality.
Lower quality means smaller files with visible loss past a point. PNG stays lossless and only sheds metadata weight.

faqs.q: Why is my PNG barely smaller?
faqs.a: Lossless PNG has a floor. Convert to JPG or WEBP for much smaller files.

faqs.a: Shrinking is safe. Enlarging stretches existing pixels, so huge upscales soften. The upscale tool rebuilds detail instead.

faqs.q: What does keep aspect ratio do?
faqs.a: It locks width to height, so typing one side computes the other and nothing stretches.
